decks.notes: The main focus of this Dredge combo deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Shambling Shell through mechanics like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder. By utilizing the Dredge ability, you can quickly bring back powerful creatures like Narcomoeba, Prized Amalgam, and Ichorid from the graveyard to overwhelm your opponent. This deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect your combo, while also utilizing cards like Creeping Chill to drain your opponent's life total. The goal is to quickly generate a strong board presence and win the game through aggressive graveyard interactions.

This deck focuses on using efficient spells and powerful mana acceleration to control the game early and maintain tempo advantage. By leveraging cheap disruptive cards like Mental Misstep, Pyroblast, and Swords to Plowshares, as well as counterspells like Force of Will, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying its own threats. Cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Dreadhorde Arcanist provide value by recurring spells from the graveyard, while cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Faerie Mastermind provide additional aggressive threats to close out the game quickly.

The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to quickly bring powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. It also utilizes control elements like counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and protect the Oath strategy. The deck has a strong mana base with efficient mana rocks and dual lands to ensure consistent plays and powerful interactions. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping into game-winning threats with Oath of Druids.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and combo pieces to control the game and engineer a win. By tutoring for powerful spells and utilizing mana acceleration, the deck aims to lock down the opponent's options while setting up its win condition, which often involves using Time Vault with Voltaic Key or Goblin Engineer. Additionally, the deck includes counterspells and card draw to maintain control over the game. The goal is to outmaneuver the opponent while assembling the necessary pieces for a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on setting up a quick and efficient win condition through the use of Dark Ritual, Doomsday, and Thassa's Oracle. It aims to assemble the combo pieces needed to win the game in a single turn, using powerful tutors and card draw spells to search for key cards and protect the combo with countermagic. The strategy revolves around careful sequencing of spells and managing resources effectively to execute the Doomsday combo and win the game in a decisive manner.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts to disrupt your opponent while quickly ramping up mana to deploy threats like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Nettlecyst. The deck includes disruptive cards like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst to slow down opponents, along with mana denial cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine. The deck also features versatile cards like Phyrexian Metamorph and Karn, the Great Creator to adapt to different situations. By combining aggressive strategies with powerful artifacts, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The deck heavily focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to combo off with various cards such as Brain Freeze, Tinker, and Bolas's Citadel to generate infinite loops and win the game quickly. It also includes key control elements like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. With a high density of powerful cards like Black Lotus, Ancestral Recall, and Time Walk, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly while maintaining interaction to secure the win.

This deck focuses on playing powerful Hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining Aggro strategies with hate cards, it aims to slow down the opponent while applying pressure with efficient creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Outland Liberator. The deck also includes equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat to further bolster its aggressive game plan. With a mix of mana acceleration and disruptive elements, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game and overwhelm the opponent with its efficient threats.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through cards such as Tolarian Academy, Mishra's Workshop, Mana Crypt, and Grim Monolith. This mana is then used to cast spells that can draw additional cards, such as Paradoxical Outcome, in order to chain together a storm of spells. This allows the player to generate even more mana and draw more cards, ultimately leading to the combo win condition of using Time Vault and Voltaic Key to take infinite turns. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Will to protect the combo and control the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats early in the game. The deck also includes various free spells like Force of Will and Force of Vigor to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own creatures. The inclusion of cards like Noxious Revival and Master of Death ensures the deck can continue to bring back creatures from the graveyard and maintain pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful combo of Underworld Breach and Hullbreacher to generate massive card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing efficient card draw and tutors, along with key mana rocks like Black Lotus and Moxen, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a win condition such as Brain Freeze. With a mix of countermagic and disruption, the deck aims to protect its combo while disrupting the opponent's strategy, leading to a fast and dominating victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful combo using cards like Paradoxical Outcome, Time Vault, and Bolas's Citadel to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage, while also disrupting the opponent with countermagic and stax pieces like Hullbreacher. The deck aims to win the game through a combination of drawing cards, controlling the board, and overwhelming the opponent with a game-winning combo before they have a chance to respond effectively.

The deck revolves around assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game quickly and efficiently. The key strategy involves using powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Necropotence to draw cards and find essential pieces, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Duress and Force of Will. By carefully sequencing spells and utilizing various tutors and cantrips, the deck aims to set up a winning pile with Doomsday that can be executed in a single turn for a decisive victory.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the game using powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Treasure Cruise while also utilizing creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dreadhorde Arcanist to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, while also generating card advantage and tempo advantage with cards like Expressive Iteration and Lurrus of the Dream-Den. The deck also includes a manabase with powerful lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing control of the game through a combination of powerful mana acceleration, disruptive counterspells, and efficient threats. By using cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to ramp into threats like Sphinx of the Steel Wind and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, while also controlling the opponent's resources with cards like Force of Will and Hullbreacher, the deck aims to set a fast pace and dictate the tempo of the game. The inclusion of Tinker and Time Vault also allows for potential game-ending combos that can quickly secure victory.

This deck focuses on generating card advantage through cards like Expressive Iteration, Ancestral Recall, and Treasure Cruise while maintaining control with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation. It uses aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dreadhorde Arcanist to pressure the opponent while disrupting their mana base with cards like Wasteland and Spreading Seas. The deck aims to quickly out value and out pace the opponent in order to win the game.
